## What the ruling fixes (5902360492)

- **The rule is unchanged.** `AGENTS.md`: 「Runtime strings — refusal prose, prescriptions, anything an author is shown — carry no tracker number (`pnpm check:doc-authoring`): the lesson goes into the text.」
- **End state:** the tracker numbers leave runtime text in stages, per package, until the `check:doc-authoring` ledger (`scripts/doc-authoring-prose-id.baseline.json`) is empty.
- **Scope, all three categories:** runtime strings (refusals, prescriptions, log lines), metadata text shown to authors and administrators (object and field descriptions and their translations), and the test strings shipped under `src/`.
- **Form:** each rewritten string states what the cited card decided, in words (form D, as #20233 did). Author-visible text first, log lines last.
- **Mechanics:** one PR per stage, each recomputing the ledger with `--census-ledger` in the same PR. The ledger only shrinks, and every lane's stages share that one file, so they are serial. `domain:engine`'s five stages on #20513 run first; this card is `Blocked-by: #20513`.
